751-1879-3286.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

728-4452-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
728-4452-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2393-3249-6723--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2393-3249-6723--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Sifter of Skulls triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1283-1999-7340.easyPrerequisites: Master Transmuter does not have summoning sickness.
1283-1999-7340.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C} which you can spend to as though it were mana of any color as long as Chromatic Orrery is on the battlefield.
Cast Sewer-veillance Cam by paying {C}.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, targeting Master Transmuter.
Holding priority, activate Master Transmuter by paying {C}, tapping it, and returning Sewer-veillance Cam from the battlefield to your hand.
When Sewer-veillance Cam leaves the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Master Transmuter.
In response to the Master Transmuter activation from step 4, activate Master Transmuter again by paying {C} and returning the tapped Chromatic Orrery from the battlefield to your hand, putting Chromatic Orrery from your hand onto the battlefield untapped.
Resolve the remaining Master Transmuter ability, putting Sewer-veillance Cam from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, untapping Master Transmuter.
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C} which you can spend to as though it were mana of any color as long as Chromatic Orrery is on the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have infinite mana, you may repeat the loop but activate Chromatic Orrery's last ability instead of its mana ability in step 9, drawing cards.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1603-1619-3908.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1603-1619-3908.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Spark Double and Evil Twin each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Evil Twin trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1603-1619-3908.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1453-2034--5.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Repeat.

2457-2557-4289-4478.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

206-339-677-2034.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3388-6972.description:
Cast Moritte by paying {2}{G}{U}{U}. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Isilu.
Put Moritte into your graveyard due to the legend rule. When it dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its ability. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Isilu.
Repeat step 2.

1445-2060-6413-7176.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2060-6413-7176.description:
Activate Oko's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing Crystalline Crawler to gain all creature types.
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card.
Green Goblin's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-6972-7156.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Arcbound Hybrid.
When Arcbound Hybrid dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Hybrid's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Hybrid from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
When Arcbound Hybrid enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1238-2351-5147-5467-7040.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

147-780-4050.description:
Cast Supernatural Stamina by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Supernatural Stamina, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Supernatural Stamina.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

628-2366-3385-6931.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
628-2366-3385-6931.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters, Tourach's Chant and Aether Flash trigger.
Resolve the Tourach's Chant trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on Dryad Arbor.
Dryad Arbor dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Dryad Arbor enters, Tourach's Chant and Aether Flash trigger.
Resolve the Tourach's Chant trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Aether Flash trigger, dealing damage to Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 4.

1018-1987-2128.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature, or land that can produce at least {U} the turn it enters the battlefield.
1018-1987-2128.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U} due to Hinata, blinking Skullwinder and the permanent tapped for mana in step 1.
When Skullwinder enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2511-6872--5.easyPrerequisites: One of the persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2511-6872--5.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a persist creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Long Feng trigger.
Resolve the Long Feng trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other persist creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-5411-6701.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

74-2043-4359-6311.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Urza's ability, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Resolve both Urza abilities, creating two token copies of Radiant Lotus that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creatures.
Activate a Radiant Lotus token by tapping it and sacrificing both Radiant Lotus tokens, targeting yourself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying the Radiant Lotus token's ability, targeting yourself.
Resolve both Radiant Lotus abilities, adding twelve mana of any color.
Repeat.

1477-5004-5660.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Cathodion, targeting Evolution Witness.
When Cathodion dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Cathodion from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Cathodion by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2084-6618.description:
Cast Relm's Sketching by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
Activate the Mirror-Mad Phantasm token by paying {1}{U}, shuffling the token into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

2382-5256-5659--33.notablePrerequisites: One Lhurgoyf must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mimic Vat.
2382-5256-5659--33.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a nontoken Lhurgoyf.
When the Lhurgoyf dies, Mimic Vat triggers, exiling the Lhurgoyf from your graveyard and returning the Lhurgoyf that was exiled to your graveyard.
Disa's first ability triggers, putting the Lhurgoyf from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed Lhurgoyf's power.
Repeat.

804-3546-3783-4300-6200.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures of the type chosen with Three Tree City.
804-3546-3783-4300-6200.description:
Activate Three Tree City's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least four mana of any color.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning Three Tree City from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Activate High Market's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing the Illusion.
When the Illusion dies, Sakashima the Impostor and Minn's second abilities trigger.
Holding priority, activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning High Market from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor and Minn triggers, putting Three Tree City and High Market from your hand onto the battlefield, choosing any creature type for Three Tree City that you control at least four creatures of.
Repeat.

Any creature on the battlefield has 1 or 2 power.

Activate Moritte of the Frost's first loyalty ability by adding 0 loyalty counters, dealing 3 damage to target creature and having that creature deal 1 or 2 damage to Moritte of the Frost.

You must repeat the last step in a mandatory loop, resulting in a game draw.

1379-1912-2043-2470.description:
Activate Urza by paying {4}, creating a token copy of Biomancer's Familiar that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate Grand Architect's second ability by tapping the Biomancer's Familiar token, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Urza by paying at most {2}, creating a token copy of Biomancer's Familiar that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate Grand Architect's second ability by tapping the Biomancer's Familiar token, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite colorless mana, you may target any other permanent using Urza's ability.

130-1636.notablePrerequisites:
Jungle Patrol does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {G}.
130-1636.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures by tapping them, adding at least {G}.
Activate Jungle Patrol's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, creating a 0/1 Wood creature token.
When the Wood token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
If needed, activate Jungle Patrol's second ability by sacrificing the Wood token, adding {R}.
Repeat.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may forego sacrificing the Wood tokens.

4222-4249-4665.notablePrerequisites:
Crackling Emergence and Freed from the Real attached to Nykthos.
Your devotion to blue is at least four.
4222-4249-4665.description:
Activate Nykthos' second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Nykthos.
Repeat.

215-546-1034.notablePrerequisites: Ramos has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
215-546-1034.description:
Activate Ramos by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Ramos to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Ramos by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Lux Artillery triggers, causing Ramos to gain sunburst and enter the battlefield with five +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

1914-2500-3169-4659-4840.description:
Cast Myr Battlesphere by paying {7}.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Genesis Chamber.
Resolve the Myr Battlesphere trigger, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Resolve the Genesis Chamber trigger, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks five times by sacrificing the Myr tokens, adding ten {C}.
Activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, targeting Myr Battlesphere.
Cowardice triggers, returning Myr Battlepshere from the battlefield to your hand.
Mirage Mirror's ability fails to resolve  due to no longer having a legal target.
Repeat.

2857-4364-5256.description:
Declare Aurelia as an attacker.
Aurelia triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, making it so the next time Aurelia dies this turn it will be returned to the battlefield.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Aurelia.
Adarkar Valkyrie triggers, returning Aurelia to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia's ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Aurelia's power.
Repeat.

518-1691-3509-3733.notablePrerequisites: an additional creature on the battlefield.
518-1691-3509-3733.description:
Before damage cast Ephemeral Shields, targeting any creature.
Mirrorwing Dragon's ability triggers, copying Shields to the other creatures and giving each indestructible until the end of turn.
Cast Jeskai Charm, choosing the mode to give your creatures lifelink until the end of turn.
Cast Arcbond, targeting one of the creatures.
Mirrorwing Dragon's ability triggers, copying Arcbond onto the other creatures.
Once a creature takes damage, the ability given by Arcbond triggers, reflecting the damage onto all players and all other creatures.
Because of lifelink, you gain life while all other players lose life.
As the ability deals damage to the other creatures you control, their Arcbond abilities trigger in response, doing the same.
